homeContradiction.explanation: Previous preview listed `home` for import while `/` and `/home` were still static-primary because app/page.tsx and app/home/page.tsx were not wired to resolveClonePage. That wiring is now done.

/.winner: Published valid content_pages row for slug=root wins; otherwise static homepageServices registry document.

/home.winner: Published valid content_pages row for slug=home wins; otherwise static glinaBoxPage registry document.
/home.note: /home is the GLINA BOX marketing page — distinct from `/` workshop picker.

omittedResolved.pracowniaMidCopy: Represented as section type mid-copy (no schema migration)
omittedResolved.grupyIntroWho: Represented as section type bullet-list (ids intro-bullets, who-bullets)
omittedResolved.servicePageNested: Each /service-page/* archive fixture registered as content_pages clone-page-v1 with ASCII cmsSlug

adminEditingCoverage.rollback: Unpublish/archive/delete content_pages row by slug → public resolveClonePage falls back to static registry automatically

visualParity.method: Structural fingerprint equality + adapter round-trip for every proposed document; Playwright viewport renders generated in cms-visual-parity.ts when server available
visualParity.note: With empty Supabase content_pages, live pages already use static-fallback documents identical to proposed seed JSON — DB-backed render equals static when content matches fingerprint.
